from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,socket,sys,tarfile
from google.protobuf import text_format
p=Path('/home/dflanag3/src/spacial_desktop/spatial-os-luna-handoff');assert socket.gethostname().split('.')[0]=='sb16-2'
os.umask(0o077);sys.path[:0]=[str(p/'tests/core'),str(p/'build/python'),str(p)]
sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],str(p/'build/identityd'),str(p/'build/spatial-issuer-client')]
from test_issuer_client import ClientProcess
from test_identity_enrollment import EnrollmentFixture
import issuer_pb2 as pb
fixture=EnrollmentFixture();fixture.setUp()
bundle=p/'local/m01-client-crosshost-fixture.tar';folder=p/'local/m01-client-crosshost';folder.mkdir()
try:
 with tarfile.open(bundle) as archive:
  members=archive.getmembers()
  assert {m.name for m in members}=={'connection.json','server.crt','service.crt','service.pem'}
  for m in members:
   assert m.isfile() and m.size<65536
   (fixture.root/m.name).write_bytes(archive.extractfile(m).read())
 metadata=json.loads((fixture.root/'connection.json').read_text());assert metadata['host']=='sb16'
 config=pb.IssuerTlsClientConfig(protocol_version=1,address=socket.gethostbyname('sb16'),port=metadata['port'],
  server_name='issuer.test',server_ca_path=str(fixture.root/'server.crt'),certificate_path=str(fixture.root/'service.crt'),
  private_key_path=str(fixture.root/'service.pem'),issuer_id=bytes.fromhex(metadata['issuer_id']),
  issuer_public_key=bytes.fromhex(metadata['issuer_public_key']),io_timeout_ms=3000)
 path=fixture.root/'client.textproto';path.write_text(text_format.MessageToString(config))
 client=ClientProcess(path,fixture.root/'client.log');fixture.addCleanup(client.close)
 info=client.call(info=pb.IssuerInfoRequest()).info
 assert info.issuer_id.hex()==metadata['issuer_id'] and info.public_key.hex()==metadata['issuer_public_key']
 enrolled=fixture.enroll(client);claims=fixture.claims(enrolled,info)
 challenge=client.call(authentication_begin=pb.AuthenticationBegin(credential=enrolled.credential,
  audience='cross-host-client-fixture',channel_binding=b'z'*32)).challenge
 result=client.call(authentication_complete=pb.AuthenticationComplete(nonce=challenge.nonce,
  proof=fixture.proof(challenge,fixture.actor_key,fixture.actor_public))).authentication
 assert result.identity.actor_id==claims.actor_id and result.identity.active and result.channel_binding==b'z'*32
 record={'status':'passed','client_host':'sb16-2','server_host':'sb16','client_program':'spatial-issuer-client',
  'checks':['production client server trust and name verification','mutual TLS','pinned issuer identity',
            'real automatic enrollment','independent issuer credential signature','context-bound fresh actor authentication'],
  'client_binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'build/spatial-issuer-client').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  'test_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'tests/core/test_issuer_client.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 (folder/'client.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
finally:
 fixture.doCleanups();bundle.unlink()

checks: production client server trust and name verification
